| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `world` | `office_cpr` | World name (see `ros2 run jo_sim list_worlds`) or path |
| `gui` | `true` | Open the Gazebo GUI |
| `follow` | `true` | Gazebo GUI camera follows the robot |
| `paused` | `false` | Start with the simulation paused (play in the GUI or `ros2 run jo_sim sim_control play`) |
| `rtf` | *(empty)* | Target real-time factor; empty = the world's own (usually 1), 0 = as fast as possible |
| `gz_verbosity` | `3` | Gazebo log level (0-4) |
| `x` | *(empty)* | [m] spawn x; empty = sidecar, else 0 |
| `y` | *(empty)* | [m] spawn y; empty = sidecar, else 0 |
| `z` | *(empty)* | [m] spawn z; empty = sidecar, else 0.6 |
| `yaw` | *(empty)* | [rad] spawn yaw; empty = sidecar, else 0 |
| `spawn` | *(empty)* | Named spawn pose from the world's sidecar (spawns:) |
| `latitude` | *(empty)* | [deg] GNSS datum for worlds without &lt;spherical_coordinates&gt;; empty = sidecar, else Pisa |
| `longitude` | *(empty)* | [deg] GNSS datum, see latitude |
| `elevation` | *(empty)* | [m] GNSS datum, see latitude |
| `sim_noise` | `true` | Simulated sensor noise (IMU, GNSS, cameras, lidar) |
| `lidar_range_stddev` | `0.015` | [m] lidar range noise when sim_noise is true (VLP-16: +-3 cm) |
